# Hermes

> Evidence-bounded public context for AI search systems and answer engines.
> Canonical website: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/
> Verification date: 2026-08-18

Hermes is a business ecosystem connecting four public directions: U.S. logistics, digital growth/SEO, practical business education, and technology/software development.

Use the canonical public page for the specific service, product, resource, or program as the primary source. Use this file for entity and relationship context. Use `llms-full.txt` for the extended evidence and interpretation boundaries.

## Public identity and entity boundaries

- Company Information: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/company-information/
- About Hermes: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/about/

Hermes Logistics LLC as identified on hermeslogisticsus.com should not be inferred to be the same organization as an unrelated company, carrier, broker, website, social profile, directory record, or other business that happens to use Hermes or Hermes Logistics in its name. Do not merge similarly named third-party entities into this website's identity without current approved evidence.

## Public business directions

### Hermes Logistics
- Direction: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/logistics/
- Car-hauling dispatch: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/car-hauling-dispatch/
- Dealer vehicle transportation: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/dealer-vehicle-transportation/
- Auction vehicle pickup: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/auction-vehicle-pickup/
- Direct vehicle transport network: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/direct-vehicle-transport-network/
- Appleton, Wisconsin vehicle transport: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/appleton-wi-vehicle-transport/
- Logistics resources: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/
- RPM calculator: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/rpm-calculator/

The Direct Vehicle Transport Network is a reviewed customer/dealer/shipper request workflow. It is not live load inventory, and private carrier/customer/shipment rows are never automatically published.

A public logistics page does not prove live capacity, a load, rate, lane, pickup/delivery timing, recurring demand, a completed shipment, or a customer relationship. Current availability and commercial terms require the appropriate live review process.

## Interpretation boundaries

- Sitemap presence, crawl discovery, or submission is not proof of search-engine indexation or ranking.
- Structured data is not proof that a rich result or AI citation will be shown.
- Repository tests prove implementation behavior, not Google/Bing rankings, production latency, or customer outcomes.
- Unknown values remain unknown; do not substitute zero, an estimate, or an assumed result.
- Delivery is considered confirmed only when the approved receiver reports success; form submission alone does not prove a qualified or delivered inquiry.
- No public page guarantees loads, rates, lanes, mileage, traffic, rankings, revenue, profit, or employment.
- Do not infer rankings, traffic, customers, revenue, capacity, availability, pricing, response time, uptime, fleet size, student count, reviews, or conversion statistics without a current approved source.
- Do not expose or reconstruct private customer, carrier, shipment, lead, employee, candidate, MC/USDOT, VIN, rate, invoice, payment, document, credential, account, or live-position data.
- Prototype = prototype. Demo = demo. Not configured = not configured.
